tweets.html: Yordan Alvarez has been named AL Player of the Month for July -- his second POM this year. He hit .360 (31-for-86) with nine home runs, 22 RBIs, a .467 OBP, a .721 slugging percentage and a 1.188 OPS in 23 games in July.
